delivery_role_note: Permission-gated helpers such as geolocation or notifications remain subordinate to the public answer lane so denial, blocked state, or unsupported state does not become the reason a voter cannot read the current official answer.
denied_prompt_unsupported_state_note: Denied, blocked, unsupported, or policy-restricted states are treated as normal public states and fail open to a readable first-party answer or help lane.
manual_fallback_note: Manual address entry, browsable lists, and ordinary help/contact paths remain visible when a permission-gated helper is unavailable.
notification_opt_in_boundary_note: Notification opt-in is separate from first-contact answer delivery and is never requested automatically on page load.
permission_surface_label: Example State official voter-information browser-permission and device-capability fail-open policy
permissions_policy_and_embed_scope_note: The office reviews Permissions-Policy and embed boundaries so powerful capabilities are enabled only where truly needed and do not spill into third-party frames by accident.
public_read_without_permissions_note: Reading the current official answer and reaching the ordinary help lane does not require granting browser or device permissions.
request_trigger_and_explanation_note: Permission prompts appear only after a clear user action that explains the benefit, such as finding nearby locations or enabling reminders, rather than on page load.
